description: Source code for the abstract MemoryManager class in Apache Spark, managing shared memory between execution and storage, including memory pools, allocation, and release methods.

classes.name: MemoryManager
classes.description: An abstract class managing memory sharing between execution and storage in Spark, with methods for allocation, release, and memory pool management.

methods.name: setMemoryStore
methods.description: Sets the MemoryStore used for evicting cached blocks.

methods.name: acquireStorageMemory
methods.description: Attempts to acquire memory for caching a block.

methods.name: acquireUnrollMemory
methods.description: Attempts to acquire memory for unrolling a block.

methods.name: acquireExecutionMemory
methods.description: Attempts to acquire execution memory for a task.

methods.name: releaseExecutionMemory
methods.description: Releases execution memory for a task.

methods.name: releaseAllExecutionMemoryForTask
methods.description: Releases all execution memory for a specific task.

methods.name: executionMemoryUsed
methods.description: Returns total execution memory in use.

methods.name: storageMemoryUsed
methods.description: Returns total storage memory in use.

methods.name: onHeapExecutionMemoryUsed
methods.description: Returns on-heap execution memory in use.

methods.name: offHeapExecutionMemoryUsed
methods.description: Returns off-heap execution memory in use.

methods.name: onHeapStorageMemoryUsed
methods.description: Returns on-heap storage memory in use.

methods.name: offHeapStorageMemoryUsed
methods.description: Returns off-heap storage memory in use.

methods.name: getExecutionMemoryUsageForTask
methods.description: Returns execution memory used by a specific task.
